name: app-dark-and-lime-blue-crypto-course-app-three-phones
title: Crypto Course App in Black, Lime and Blue
whatItIs: Three phones on grey: a black screen with a lime wave-textured course card and a blue card with tags and pill nav, a periwinkle detail screen with a translucent 3D shape, a profile pill, a rating and Enroll and like buttons, and a black calendar screen with a lime selected date.
whatItMeans: Lime and periwinkle on black feel modern and techy, and joined blob shapes make cards and buttons feel liquid.
techniques: Cards and buttons with joined blob notches
Lime wave texture inside a card
Periwinkle as a full-screen colour for the detail page
Lime as the selected state in the calendar
Pill nav with a raised active button

vocabulary.definition: A rounded cut joining a card to an adjacent button.
A ripple pattern used as a gradient fill.
A highlighted day in a calendar.
